title: Skyhaven
summary: A tour of the Hub village: the plaza, the Bank, the merchants, the Grand Bazaar, the Arcane Library, Starwatch and the Hub's gate to your island.

s.x: Skyhaven is a floating town above the clouds: the village at the centre of the
Hub

, where you shop, bank, reforge and start slayer quests. You reach it through the portal on your Private Island. The village is a safe place. This page walks round it by area, with coordinates so you can find things on the map. The islands around it are on
The Hub
. North is the negative Z direction, and the Skyheart plaza is at 0, 0.
The Hub is its own dimension. Your Private Island and the public islands are separate from it.
Everyone walks
60% faster
in the Hub, so getting from one merchant to the next is quick. The boost ends the moment you leave the Hub.

In the village nobody can fight, break blocks, place blocks or take damage, and nobody gets hungry. The seven areas around it let you break what they are for (Wheat, Oak, Coal and so on, which grow back) and fight the mobs that live there. See
The Hub
You can use doors, trapdoors, fence gates, buttons, levers and bells. Other blocks, such as chests, cannot be used.
Fields cannot be trampled.
If you fall off the island you land back at spawn.
Block items, buckets and spawn eggs cannot be used here.
/hub
brings you here from anywhere, after a few seconds of standing still.
/is
takes you to your Private Island.

s.x: The bridges from the village lead on to the Graveyard, Coal Mine, Farm, Forest, Ruins, Mountain and Wilderness: see
The Hub
. Every NPC also shows up on your minimap and world map with their face, name and role. See
NPCs
The plaza is the middle of the town. A golden beacon fountain rises under the floating
Skyheart

, a spinning amethyst crystal ringed with purple shards. Eight runestones with banners stand round the edge, between four avenues, with cherry planters and benches facing the fountain. Hidden lights keep it bright at night.
The plaza is where you arrive when you use
/hub
, a little south of the fountain. Hypixel's other Hub spots (the Museum, the Fashion Shop and so on) are not built yet.
The avenue north of the plaza climbs to the raised
Crown Terrace
Skyhaven Bank
, with a copper dome. The Banker keeps your bank balance and pays you interest. See
Coins and the bank
The Emberforge
, where Rosetta sells armour sets and the Blacksmith reforges your weapons, armour and tools. See
Reforging
The Mason's Guild
, where the Wool Weaver sells wool, glass and clay in every colour.
The windmill
, with turning sails, on the north-west edge. The Mine Merchant stands near it, selling ores, stone and pickaxes.
Greenhollow is a working farm with fields, and the Farm Merchant sells crops and seeds there. Further west the
Mistfall
waterfall pours from the island onto a small pond islet below.
Timberline Lodge
sits among great trees. The Lumber Merchant buys logs and sells wood and axes.
Just off the south avenue, on the lawn in front of the gazebo, stands the
brainrot podium
: statues of the three best brainrot collectors on gold, silver and copper pedestals, with their scores. See
Brainrots
The tavern, with a beer garden and a gazebo, is where the Bartender sells drinks. The build calls the building the Gilded Gull. A bridge from the beer garden leads to the Arcane Library.

blocks.text: The east: the Bazaar Promenade and the Grand Bazaar

s.x: The east avenue is a tree-lined promenade with benches, flower planters, banner posts and a koi garden with a brook. It ends at the
Bazaar Gate
, a great arch with a hanging "GRAND BAZAAR" sign, and a wide dark-oak bridge leads from it to the
Grand Bazaar
islet.
The Grand Bazaar is a market. A 19 by 19 plaza with a bell tower fountain sits in the middle, and six merchant pavilions stand round it:
There is a pond and dock east of the Angler.
Seraphine Vael's enchanting hall stands on an islet to the south-east. Inside, a giant open book floats under a crystal. Talk to her to open the enchanting table. See
Enchanting

On its own islet to the south stands a great stone ring with a shimmering purple veil. A sign on it sends you home: walk through and you are on your Private Island. The portal on your island brings you back.

Starwatch is a small observatory islet in the north-east, reached from the terrace. Right-click the telescope and you get a short stargazing show: fireworks burst into stars over the observatory, a field of sparkles fills the sky, and you get Night Vision for 15 seconds.
The first time you look through it you earn the
Stargazer
advancement and
500 coins
. Only one person can use the telescope at a time.
The minimap in the top right shows the town and its NPCs. The map opens zoomed in when you are in the hub.
Press
M
for the world map. Hover an icon to see who it is.
Drop a waypoint on a spot you want to return to. See
Waypoints
/warp
takes you to the areas and islands you have already visited. See
SkyBlock Menu
Not sure where an NPC is? Open the world map and look for their face. Hover to see their role.
